facts.fact: Educationactu reports that since 2024 Guinea's education ministry, through the DGECS, has run a platform (dgecsecoles.com) giving each pupil a matricule number and holding exam marks, enrolling grades 7 and 11 in 2024-25 and extending to intermediate primary and secondary classes except grade 9 in 2025-26.

GIN.note: Education platform article; states nothing on health data.
Education platform article; states nothing on health reporting.

facts.fact: Guinean schools must register pupils on the DGECS platform, which gives each a matricule number, and enter composition marks, grades 7 and 11 in 2024-25 and intermediate classes in 2025-26; parents report unentered marks and unregistered pupils, and the DG says some heads neglected the platform.

GIN.note: No share or count of schools entering data is given.
Education platform article; states nothing on tax filing or payment.
